Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
A Imbued is incapacitated with 0 life. He moves to the ready region using Jennie's special.
Does he gain an additional life? Or is Cassie's cardtext a reminder?

For instance, Bond's cardtext is a reminder

groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/dxSfc4tm58Y/ng4XwPRD0-MJ

Name: Jennie "Cassie247" Orne
Cardtype: Imbued
Creed: Visionary
Group: 4
Life: 5
Virtue: inn jud vis
Any incapacitated imbued may move to the ready region and gain a life (not to exceed his or her starting amount) by burning 2 conviction [2 CONVICTION] during any Methuselah's untap phase.

Name: Bond
[NoR:C]
Cardtype: Action
Virtue: Innocence
+1 stealth action.
Move an incapacitated imbued to his or her controller's ready region. That imbued gains a life (not to exceed his or her starting amount).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> A Imbued is incapacitated with 0 life. He moves to the ready region using Jennie's special.
> Does he gain an additional life? Or is Cassie's cardtext a reminder?
>
The Imbued ends up in the ready region with just one life.

The rules didn't (originally) state that Imbued got one life when coming out of the incapacitated region by methods other than the rulebook "burn 3 conviction" option. Jennie "Cassie247" Orne was printed without the life text, but her online card text has been clarified since.
